integration: Real FileViewer, element comments, manual editor, PreviewDrawOverlay and runtime bridges. Cindy owns conversation/model execution. Local Node routes replace daemon routes.
patches: FileViewer: force native srcdoc interaction path; hide unavailable cloud sharing/handoff.
registry: scope raw/base URLs to isolated read-only project origin; source fetch omits preview watcher.
srcdoc snapshot: preserve hidden nodes by computed visibility; avoid index-based pruning after script removal, which incorrectly removed page content.
zh-CN: rename composer action to Save feedback because it persists context rather than inserting into Cindy composer.
FullStudio adapter: same-session feedback, annotation images, manual saves, source refresh, hide unsupported history.
Both i18n providers: use host-injected locale with English fallback, omit OS/browser/localStorage preference discovery. Draft feedback labels reflect persistence rather than composer insertion.
CommentSendResult: preserve unknown without treating it as successful submission.
Entity decoders: decode once rather than reinterpreting newly decoded ampersands. PDF print title escapes script terminators; CSS selector fallback escapes backslashes.
FileViewer and registry: hash the exact source used for each manual edit, undo/redo, speaker-note or inspect save and supply expectedRevision to the local atomic writer.

Manual text editing: replace iframe-owned contenteditable/commit messages with the Cindy adapter ManualInlineTextEditor in the editor origin; private one-use authorization on trusted input, active target/original source checks, and fail-closed conflict settlement.

Manual canvas input: capture trusted gestures in the editor origin; iframe hit testing is advisory. Reject iframe selection/text/drag authority; derive text input position and drag displacement from parent pointer coordinates.
Persisted free-pin and file-comment identifiers use crypto.randomUUID rather than timestamp/Math.random.
UUID utility: preserve cryptographic getRandomValues fallback, remove Math.random fallback; reuse in free-pin sandbox bridge and file-comment creation.
Remove artifact-frame download authority, including thumbnails; srcdoc download links propose bounded blobs to a parent-owned trusted Save file control.
DownloadGate: accept explicitly marked version/presentation frames and portal trusted save controls into fullscreen/presentation; keep inactive thumbnails outside download authority.
